src/daemon/connection-management-rpc.ts.rationale: S004: exact ticket-only sc6 state/retry endpoints and existing remove intent require capability readiness before ticket/owner work. Presented session authority is never stripped to reach Saved. Fixed error projection; no legacy-delete fallback.

src/daemon/connection-session-rpc.ts.rationale: S004: existing socket/root/generation/workbench-ui gates precede remove receipts and cleanup. Temporary deletion and ledger publication share the current owner; no activation after remove. Stored edit probes retain the existing resolver lease through actual child drain. All-consumer Saved worker affinity remains a separate pending prerequisite.

src/daemon/db-rpc.ts.rationale: S004: legacy Saved upsert/delete compatibility is unchanged. A probe that borrows a persisted config now holds the existing Saved resolver lease through the supervisor drain; new unsaved drafts do not gain a fictitious stored revision. No session-to-Saved downgrade.

src/daemon/db/draft-test.ts.rationale: S004: the existing supervisor supplies its private true-drain promise to preparation. It resolves only after preparation and actual child close or failed spawn, preserving timeout/cancel response independence and allowing the existing revision lease to remain held. No new wire or persisted lifetime field.

src/daemon/db/management.ts.rationale: S004: existing Saved root gate, MAC/ticket authority, registry and credential journal atomically remove one selected revision. Ambiguous commit retains the old runtime barrier until exact same-ticket inode/receipt reconciliation. Detach precedes asynchronous cleanup; credential and resource phases are independently truthful. No source deletion or new store.

src/daemon/db/pool.ts.rationale: S004: exact opaque prepare/commit/cancel tokens reuse the existing revision gate. Strict detach transfers only old SDK/build handles to bounded cleanup ownership and invalidates acquisition before release. Failed closes retain ownership; old cleanup cannot target a recreated ID. This is process-local ownership, not global worker affinity proof.

src/daemon/db/secrets.ts.rationale: S004: metadata-only removal preparation reuses the protected sc2 journal, owns no staged replacement secrets, and selects only obsolete owned refs. Credential recovery uses existing fences and protected receipts; no plaintext credential is reconstructed for removal/state/retry. Protected cleanup refs remain internal, never sc6 wire/log values.

src/daemon/db/session-entries.ts.rationale: S004: memory-only prepare/commit/cancel removal uses the existing revision barrier and synchronous receipt revision. Logical deletion drops config/staging refs and live byte budget, while exact retired resources retain a shared 64-slot session reservation and removed-ID guard until close. No registry/keychain/cache reconstruction.

src/daemon/db/session-ledger.ts.rationale: S004: existing bounded in-memory HMAC ledger admits remove and publishes the unchanged safe removed/not-applicable outcome in the same synchronous turn as overlay commit. Postcommit failures return the committed receipt. No durable tombstones, second signer, separate quota or source payload serialization.

src/daemon/db/session-management.ts.rationale: S004: strict bounded exact decoders plus pure safe projection compose the existing trusted binding, overlay and ledger. New state/retry select cleanup only from a verified removal receipt revision; current role/root/generation is rechecked after waits. No filesystem/keychain ports or caller-provided cleanup selectors.

src/daemon/db/session-resources.ts.rationale: S004: private exact-generation SDK/file handles transfer to bounded explicit-removal retirement. Failure retains the shared resource slot and handle; explicit removal cleanup does not poison unrelated live generations. Existing ordinary-retirement failure guards and sc8 memory-only/no-spill policy remain unchanged. Expiry/shutdown drain already-owned handles without fresh admission.

src/shared/connection-management-wire.ts.rationale: S004: new ticket-only removal-state/retry decoders reject unknown fields, hidden/accessor/symbol fields, malformed bounds and non-remove tickets before owner lookup. Existing mutation, signed ticket, receipt and generic OperationStatus shapes stay unchanged; decoding does not grant authority.

src/shared/connection-management.ts.rationale: S004: additive RemovalState and ticket-only request aliases expose only key/operation/state and independent credential/resource phases. Existing sc2 persisted outcome/receipt, signed remove ticket and lease shapes are unchanged; no config or cleanup selector enters the new public contract.

src/daemon/db/removal-retirement.ts.rationale: S004: the unresolved constructor boundary is the local RemovalRetirementBudget capacity allocator, not a model/provider or driver factory. Exact opaque owner tokens reserve 64/root and 256/daemon capacity before commit. Joined retry retains failed close callbacks until physical completion; no config, signer, registry or persistent recovery store.

src/shared/connection-removal.ts.rationale: S004: pure confirmation/decision/state projection. Cancel produces no command; confirmed selection captures the revision. Only verified committed removed outcomes imply success, with fixed safe copy and independent cleanup phases. No ticket issuance, provider, filesystem, credential or resource ownership ports.

src/daemon/threads/method-class.ts.rationale: S004: additive exact endpoint classifications and main-daemon method-set membership keep removal/state/retry with existing owners. No process-local driver/authority crosses worker envelopes; all-consumer Saved affinity remains release-blocking.

src/daemon/db/management-enablement.ts.rationale: S004: source/compiled verification explicitly requires both removal helpers and all session prerequisites for sc6, including sc6-only verifier calls. Full deployed-source/build linkage still applies. Only private synthetic positive fixtures are permitted; shipped ready=false and pending external/client/affinity evidence remain unchanged.
